name: Home Screen Manager
description: TEST BUILD — Designs, orders, and renders hybrid Jellyfin/Abyss home sections using manual media, collections, metadata tags, and libraries.
overview: TEST BUILD — Home Screen Manager creation, ordering, rendering, and Abyss customization for Jellyfin 10.11.11.

versions.changelog: Adds a server-wide styled Top Row message, page visibility and Always Show modes, optional scroll persistence, subtle removable logo-only shadows, removable ranking shadows, clickable section-title destinations with sortable/filterable mixed-section pages, non-blocking Top-count warnings, and a one-click selected-section refresh button.
